name: fork_pairs_apart
description: The fork pass (M8, design 3.8): on the fork bench (tests/sim/fork_bench.gd: one seat of the form's Builder with its perk, the form built and forked on the bench cell (8, 11), health removed read from the HIT events less the killing hit's overkill), every fork pair's branches are apart. On each measure of its own job (one ground creep, one flier, armour at 4 and at 6, a crowd, holding ground creeps or fliers, lifting a battery of another seat's towers; the Sky Toll's a flier's damage and its hold on fliers), a one-creep measure at every creep health the game plays (one to four seats at every level) and a crowd or a hold on every cell its Builder's plan builds the base on, each branch does at least 25% more than its sibling (JOB_MARGIN_PM), or its sibling cannot do it at all; no branch is 10% ahead of its sibling on both jobs; and a patching branch does at most 90% of the best form, base or branch, of a Builder strong against the check it patches, at the same health or on the same cell. The watches hold one FORK_BENCH line a pair, each branch's numbers on both jobs with their range, its least lead and a patch's largest share. Generated by tools/gen_balance_scenarios.py: edit the generator, not this file.

steps.msg: every fork pair is apart: each branch 25% ahead at its own job, none 10% ahead at both, every patch at most 90% of a strong Builder's best
